name: PRONOUS
description: BSC spot-only tokenized-stock market desk for bStocks, Ondo and xStocks. Reads live RWA prices, flags unreliable gaps, offers quote and simulation, and never broadcasts without wallet, simulation, and explicit user confirmation.

services.name: MCP
services.note: Local MCP server via npm run mcp — not a public always-on MCP host

note: ERC-8004 identity is minted and independently verified on BSC Mainnet. Trading remains gated by preflight, quote, simulation, and explicit confirmation. PancakeSwap integration is quote-preview only. x402 runtime remains disabled. MCP is available as a local process, not a hosted public endpoint.
